verdict.rationale: Sentry's homepage says its own debugging agent, Seer, finds root causes and generates merge-ready patches from production issues. That is AI-generated insight and suggestion drawn from the user's data inside the product. The support rests only on two marketing lines; the Agent Tracing dashboards are about monitoring the user's own AI apps, not AI-generated insights, so they don't count here. Missing for 10: in-depth Seer product documentation, details on what insights and suggestions it surfaces and where in the UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Find root causes and fix production issues with [Seer, our debugging agent](https://sentry.io/product/seer/).
Fixes what’s broken while you ship what’s next – generating precise, merge-ready patches.
